title: paspalum setaceum var. muhlenbergii
intro: Paspalum setaceum var. muhlenbergii, commonly known as Mission Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mission Grass include promoting tissue repair and exhibiting antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mission Grass include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
